clue.text: All night I get confused after not being in a part of London

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: confused tells us the letters of all night I get are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: A muddled reveller wanders the capital all night, never quite reaching a certain district.
explanation.walkthrough: 'confused' is the anagram signal on 'All night I get', and 'after' puts that result behind 'not'. 'being in' only joins the two halves. Notting Hill Gate is an area and Underground station in west London.
explanation.definitionFit: Notting Hill Gate is a district and Tube station in west London, an example of a part of the capital.

explanation.definitionFit: A tarpaulin is a waterproof sheet used as a cover over goods or a boat.

explanation.definitionFit: Iona is a Hebridean island famous for its abbey and St Columba, an example of an island.
